verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a processor (silicon hardware). User-controlled data retention and deletion is a privacy setting of a service or software product, so the axis is a category error for a chip. The evidence pack shows no data retention or deletion feature that would make the axis apply. Mentions of on-device model execution describe where computation happens, not retention or deletion controls, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
